requirements_source: User-authorized project-defined thresholds; geometry-tolerance framework informed by GB/T 19804 and ISO 13920, numerical values are not taken from those standards
acceptance_metric: Frozen-test p95 absolute error, separately for each welding order and core target
scope: Internal simulation surrogate and decision development; fixed current geometry/material/support/cooling configuration
note: Project limits are fixed design assumptions, not standards compliance or experimental qualification. Simulation and measurement budgets remain unknown; final engineering release is not established.
